title: Polynomial-Time Computability of the Emission Function
statement: There exist a finite Turing machine $M$ over the Boolean alphabet and natural numbers $C,c$ such that, for every Boolean word $z$, $M$ halts after exactly $C(|z|+1)^c$ steps with output equal to the word-level emission function applied to $z$.
replaced:
The word-level per-round chunk program is polynomial-time computable — including
the empty finished chunks and the invalid-input fallback — with an actual finite
machine witness.
